entities.summary: Czesław Litwin was a Polish politician. He was elected to Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 9902 votes in 1 Legnica district as a candidate from Samoobrona Rzeczpospolitej Polskiej list. Litwin died on 27 September 2024, at the age of 69.

entities.summary: Czesław Litwin was a Polish politician. He was elected to Sejm on 25 September 2005, getting 9902 votes in 1 Legnica district as a candidate from Samoobrona Rzeczpospolitej Polskiej list. Litwin died on 27 September 2024, at the age of 69.
